_comment: Receive cue sets — one per radio tuner. The 'classic' set uses the current .wav samples so existing behavior is bit-identical. The 'command' set adds a SELCAL-style 2-tone pre-chirp before the click so Command-channel traffic is immediately audibly distinct from Crew-channel traffic. Define new sets here and reference them from each radio's cueSet field.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: The current PTT clicks — standard SRS key-up / key-down samples.

command.name: Command
command.description: SELCAL-style 2-tone chord preceding a crisper click — flags priority traffic so you can tell the Command channel apart from Crew at a glance.
